maya: quick note—onboarding test for atlas-lite-quant8 with 18k context showing reproducible tail token drift after a prefill boundary. repro ~3/10. logs point at partial kv writes around 0x3fe0. anyone around?

ruan: what command and env? was this on dedicated or private?

maya: dedicated d-gpu-d2. cmd: `pytest tests/longctx_onboard.py::test_prefill_boundary --model atlas-lite-quant8 --ctx 18432 --seed 202` env: `KV_PREFETCH=1 KV_WRITE_PARALLELISM=2 REDWOOD_DUMP_KV_ON_ERROR=1`

maya: snippet from run:
[2026-06-11 07:11:02] kvcache: prefill start token=12288 len=256
[2026-06-11 07:11:02] model: quant=quant8
[2026-06-11 07:11:02] WARN: kv-read length mismatch expected=256 got=248
[2026-06-11 07:11:02] ERROR: rope-phase discontinuity pos=12288 prev=0x7f curr=0x2b

sylvie: partial read + phase discontinuity screams non-atomic header update. does `KV_META_ATOMIC=1` change repro rate?

maya: set that and reran quick loop—0/12 failures vs 3/12 baseline. attaching dump `/tmp/kv-2987654321-fail.bin`. `tools/kv_inspect.py --check-rope` flags abrupt phase jump at the same offset.

omar: could quant8 packing write 8-byte words but still leave header write late. try `KV_WRITE_PARALLELISM=1` and `ROPE_SHIFT_DEBUG=1` to confirm if phase mapping changes atomically.

maya: parallelism=1 also fixed it. hypothesis: prefetch+parallel write races with metadata update causing truncated reads and rope mixing. opening ticket INF-4320 with repro script and dumps. tagging @omar @sylvie.

ci-bot: nightly bench 2026-06-12 completed for branch feature/atlas-onboard  5/120 failures; see CI for details.

sylvie: mitigation path: enable KV_META_ATOMIC default for quant packers and add a unit test that toggles prefetch+evict patterns. we'll follow up in runtime sprint.

maya: thanks team, I9ll add the microbench and ASAN run to INF-4320 tomorrow.
